name: Murder by duet
source:
The story takes place in an ordinary Russian public school. But suddenly, during gym class, the hanged body of the class bully is discovered. You will have to figure out which duo committed the crime, but will you be able to uncover the truth?

[Translated from [url=https://t.me/mbduet/4]Telegram[/url]]
